blocks.text: Kris Aquino teased that she will make her acting comeback through short video dramas for an e-commerce platform where she serves as a brand ambassador. The Queen of All Media revealed this during the brand’s event on Monday, Sept. 28, quipping that the genre of her upcoming acting project would depend on the brand’s budget. “The higher the pay, the more they will see,” she joked, laughing. “…But we haven’t discussed what kind, what genre it will be.” “If it will be horror, which is my genre, mahal ‘yun.
